items.paraphrase: Apartment front door to nearest stair or exit: 40 m for fire class I/II, S0 structure, door between stairs (25 m on a dead-end corridor; less for lower classes).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). 40 m is the best-case row.

items.clause: Annex G, G.1.2.1 Table G.2a row 1
items.paraphrase: Public-building room door to nearest exit: 60 m for class I-III with escape flow density up to 2 persons/m2, door between exits.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). Offices fall under public buildings; limit falls with higher flow density (50/40/35/20 m).

items.paraphrase: Apartment floor area per compartment: 2500 m2 for fire class I or II with non-combustible structure, falling to 1800 or less for lower classes.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). Class I S0: 2500 m2; class II S0: 2500, S1: 2200; class III 1800; class IV 1000 or less.

items.paraphrase: Public building (office) floor per compartment, class II S0: 4000 m2 for 2 to 9 above-ground storeys, 2200 m2 at 10-16 storeys.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). Class II S0, 2-9 storeys 4000 m2, 10-16 storeys 2200 m2; office taken as a public building.

items.paraphrase: Escape stair flight at least 90 cm wide generally; 120 cm where over 200 people on a floor; 135 cm for hospital-type uses.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). 0.9 m general; 1.2 m where over 200 persons on any upper floor; 1.35 m for F1.1 buildings.

items.paraphrase: Escape stair riser no more than 22 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). Tread 25 cm minimum except outdoor stairs; riser max 22 cm.

items.paraphrase: Escape stair tread at least 25 cm, except external stairs.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). Tread 25 cm minimum except outdoor stairs; riser max 22 cm.

items.paraphrase: Clear height of habitable rooms in apartment buildings is at least 2.6 m (2.3 m for kitchens and bathrooms).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the gazette consolidated PDF

items.paraphrase: Accessible ramp slope is at most 1/12, clear width 1.2 m or more, landing every 9 m of length.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the ministry circular PDF on datafiles.chinhphu.vn (text layer).

items.paraphrase: Imposed floor load for living rooms in the national loading standard is about 1.5 kN/m2.
items.note: unverifiable_free: searched 2026-11-14: TCVN 2737:2023 on thuvienphapluat.vn, ibst.vn (only wind guide fetched), nsti.vista.gov.vn (redirect); standard is sold, only non-official mirrors or secondary summaries available

items.paraphrase: Imposed floor load for offices is about 2.0 kN/m2.
items.note: unverifiable_free: searched 2026-11-14: same hosts as residential row; standard is sold, no free official table readable

items.paraphrase: Clear width of doors to rooms inside an accessible building is at least 0.8 m; the building entrance door needs 0.9 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the ministry circular PDF on datafiles.chinhphu.vn (text layer); 0.9 m for entrance doors.

items.clause: Annex H, H.2.12.2 with Table H.2
items.paraphrase: Whole-building automatic extinguishing allows the Table H.2 compartment area to be raised up to twofold for class I/II S0 public buildings; 4000 x 2.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the Government Gazette PDF text layer (congbao.chinhphu.vn, issue 921-926/2022). Factor 2 and 4000 m2 both read; product derived. No such factor read for the residential table H.1.

items.paraphrase: The regulation asks for 1.4 m x 1.4 m clear wheelchair manoeuvring squares at ramp ends and doors; no circle diameter is given.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2024/8/06-bxd.pdf; full text has no circle diameter, only 1.4 m squares, kept unverified as a proxy
